user.title: JOYclub account
user.description: Log in to JOYclub in a browser with **Stay logged in** ticked, then export the cookies of `joyclub.com` (e.g. with a cookie editor extension) and paste the export here. Only the long-lived cookie SSOAUTOID (valid for one year) is kept; the password is never needed.

data_description.flaresolverr: e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8191 – used only if Cloudflare blocks a request.
data_description.ssoautoid: JSON export of a cookie editor, a cookies.txt, just the value of SSOAUTOID – or the path to such a file (e.g. /config/joyclub/cookies.json). With a path, the file is read again whenever JOYclub rejects the cookie, so it can be renewed automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew JOYclub cookie
reauth_confirm.description: JOYclub no longer accepts the login of **{name}**. Log in again in the browser with Stay logged in and paste the cookies of joyclub.com.

data_description.ssoautoid: JSON export of a cookie editor, a cookies.txt, just the value of SSOAUTOID – or the path to such a file (e.g. /config/joyclub/cookies.json). With a path, the file is read again whenever JOYclub rejects the cookie, so it can be renewed automatically.

error.invalid_auth: JOYclub does not accept this login any more – log in again in the browser with Stay logged in and export the cookies again.
error.no_cookie: No SSOAUTOID found. Export the cookies while the filter is set to joyclub.com (the cookie belongs to identity.joyclub.com).
error.cookie_file: Cannot read this cookie file, or it contains no SSOAUTOID.

abort.already_configured: This account is set up already.
abort.wrong_account: The cookie belongs to a different account.

data.default_hours: Duration if no end is known

data_description.target_calendar: Must allow creating events (e.g. Google Calendar). Events found there already (with the JOYclub link) are not added twice.
data_description.default_hours: Used when neither the organiser's description (a time range or a stated end) nor a learned rule gives the end. Correct the end in the target calendar once – it is learned for this party and location.
data_description.invite: E-mail addresses that get an invitation from Google for every new event (only with a Google calendar as target). Existing events are never changed in their guests.
data_description.description: Shortened as in JOYclub's “Add to calendar”, or the organiser's full text. The JOYclub link is always included.
data_description.clean_title: Decorative letters (𝗡𝗢, Ⓐ, ᴀʙᴄ, look-alike letters of other alphabets) become normal ones, emojis are removed. Also applied to events already in the target calendar: only the title is changed, guests are not notified.
data_description.abbreviations: One per line: abbreviation=replacement. “HÜ=H Ü” makes voice assistants spell it out. Only used with readable titles.

options.ask: Ask (event on the bus, answer with joyclub.answer)

refresh.name: Refresh
refresh.description: Read the registrations of all accounts now and sync the calendars.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: What the next calendar sync would do (create, change titles, delete), without changing anything. Also for accounts whose sync is still off but have a target calendar.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: Answer a question about a bookmarked or cancelled event.

answer.name: Answer
answer.description: accept/reject a bookmarked event, delete/keep a cancelled one.
